mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) decline exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals tightening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days through joint demand signals.
failure_condition: Joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both rising) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term significance p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, triggering equity sell-offs as corporate profit growth expectations decline, particularly during late-cycle economic phases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of INDPRO decline periods during late-cycle expansion, or effect not significant (p>0.05) in late-cycle regime.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as momentum builds.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of GDPC1 growth periods, or Rank IC below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of CPIAUCSL > 3.0% periods, or average return not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicates accelerating labor market strength, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days through joint labor signals.
failure_condition: Joint signal (PAYEMS up and UNRATE down) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction effect p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1300 thousand units signals a housing market boom, driving construction sector growth and consumer spending, which generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days during early economic expansions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of HOUST > 1300 periods during early-cycle expansion, or effect not significant (p>0.05) in early-cycle regime.
